ms.promise: Five project teams will convene for stakeholder meetings. The objective is to conduct three sessions focusing on roadmap discussions and the identification of at least five African countries capable of hosting the Cardano Summit 2025.
ms.criteria: A detailed roadmap and comprehensive analysis to determine the suitability of a specific city to host the Cardano Summit 2025. This will include a thorough examination of all the advantages and disadvantages associated with the chosen location, ensuring an informed decision-making process.

ms.promise: Milestone 2 will concentrate on defining research parameters and conducting initial assessments of potential venues. Six venues, including hotels for summit attendees, will be identified based on preliminary research conducted during Milestone 1. These assessments will encompass logistical, infrastructural, and security considerations for the venues identified
ms.criteria: The acceptable criteria for this milestone will center on listing the six venues and suitable hotels. Additionally, a comprehensive report will be presented outlining the factors considered by the team in selecting the venues. This report will detail logistical, infrastructural, and security considerations for the identified venues.

ms.promise: A team-wide meeting will convene to assess the results of Milestones 1 and 2. Teams will present their findings derived from the six selected cities and venues. Additionally, partnership requests and opportunities for collaboration will be discussed.
ms.criteria: Two recorded meetings will spotlight the teams' findings and presentations. Additionally, official partnership and collaboration letters will be issued. A comprehensive roadmap outlining the next steps for Milestone 4 will also be provided.

ms.promise: A designated team delegate will actively participate in blockchain conferences, engage in lobbying efforts with stakeholders, and advocate for hosting the Summit in Africa. This will involve revising the project plan and presenting a final lobbying report. Additionally, we aim to garner consolidated support from key stakeholders and refine the project proposal based on feedback received
ms.criteria: The criteria for evaluating Milestone 4 will include the number of conferences attended by the team, and list of committed partnerships and collaborations should Cardano Summit 2025 come to Africa. A report of our lobby efforts with a list of potential partners, sponsors and supporters will be shared widely within our social media platforms, in Cardano community Townhalls and X (@Africa_townhall) Spaces etc, on the projects dedicated website and during presentations at conferences.
